title: Tomato Resource Pack
description: This is a personal self made resourcepack for my Modpack and myself.
body:
# A Resource Pack for My Modpack
This resource pack was originally created for my personal modpack. It mainly changes a few textures to better fit the theme I wanted.
Updates are not planned, although I may add more changes in the future.

## Included Changes
### Crystal Theme
* Amethyst → Crystal
### Drinks
* Water Bottle → Coffee
### Food Changes
* Apple → Tomato
* Golden Apple → Golden Tomato
* Enchanted Golden Apple → Enchanted Golden Tomato

This pack was made primarily for my own use and my modpack, but anyone is welcome to use it if they find it useful.
